human_explanation: Subtract low-side absolute pressure from high-side absolute pressure. The atmospheric term cancels, so the result is also the gauge-pressure lift when both channels share the same atmospheric reference.

conditions: Both absolute-pressure inputs come from the same telemetry observation.
Both pressure channels have an applicable validated calibration identity.

release_notes: Initial formula from A/C Engine-Bay Telemetry Node Specification v1.0; no vehicle threshold or charge-state interpretation is included.
